newsitem.title: CANADA: Kimberly to sell Scott to Kruger.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly to sell Scott to Kruger.

text.p: Scott Paper Ltd said on Tuesday it entered into an agreement with Kruger Inc and a subsidiary of Kimberly-Clark Corp whereby Kruger would acquire 100 percent of the outstanding common shares of Scott for consideration of over C$351 million or C$23.00 per share.
Scott said Kruger will be assuming on a consolidated basis Scott's debt of about C$100 million for a total enterprise price to Kruger of about C$450 million.
The C$23.00 value is comprised of C$15.50 in cash and C$7.50 principal amount of 10-year 10-percent senior subordinated notes.

Scott said its board of directors will recommend that shareholders vote in favor of the deal. It said the proposal will be presented for the approval of its shareholders at a meeting to be arranged shortly.
"This proposal, which comes as a result of the sale process announced last August, is a good opportunity for all shareholders to realize value," Scott chairman Jon Grant said.

The deal must be approved by 75 percent of the votes cast by the shareholders at the shareholders' meeting, Scott said. It said a shareholders meeting will be held as soon as possible and no later than May 31 to vote on the deal, which is to be implemented by way of a statutory court-approved arrangement.

"Kruger Inc has significant tissue operations in the United Kingdom and apart and separate from Kruger Inc, the Kruger family has major tissue operations in Latin America. This will afford us many opportunities to share technology and operating practices," Scott President and Chief Executive Officer David Erskine said.
